warning.titlePre: Land Rover Velar D240 Timing Chain & Oil Dilution
paragraphs: If your Velar D240 has the Ingenium AJ200D 4-cylinder diesel — the engine fitted across the L560 generation — timing chain tensioner wear and oil dilution from DPF regeneration are well-documented patterns on this engine. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.

One owner-forum source specifically noted the D240 does not share the oil dilution issue affecting other diesels in the range — this is a single source, not independently corroborated, so we treat the broader Ingenium diesel pattern as the confirmed baseline for the D240.
warning.source: Source: shared Ingenium diesel family pattern, multiple forums. D240 oil dilution exception noted pending confirmation, per VRF
